news.title: Why Rocket Lab shares fell despite record revenue and booming Neutron demand
news.summary: Rocket Lab shares fell over 6% in after-hours trading after the company reported a wider-than-expected Q3 loss despite record revenue and a growing order backlog. Investors also weighed Neutron's delayed maiden launch, higher development costs and upbeat fourth-quarter revenue guidance.

news.title: Why The Trade Desk stock surged 15% despite revenue decline
news.summary: The Trade Desk shares surged 15.5% following stronger-than-expected Q3 earnings and revenue, as AI innovations, Netflix integration, strong customer retention and optimistic Q4 guidance boosted investor confidence despite declining profitability.

news.summary: Anthropic PBC is preparing for a live-streamed event featuring CEO Dario Amodei and JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon. news.title: RBI said to query bank valuations of some bond derivative trades
news.summary: India's central bank has informed some lenders about the need to adjust bond forward accounting practices. This change could impact billions of dollars in assets across the banking sector. The Reserve Bank of India suggested using Level 3 inputs for valuing bond-forward trades during recent audits.

news.summary: Oil prices fell due to President Trump's announcement regarding US military action against Iran, easing supply concerns. news.title: Gold dips ahead of US inflation data
news.summary: Gold prices edged lower in early Asian trade on Tuesday as investors awaited US inflation data later in the day for clues on the Federal Reserve's next policy move.

news.title: Dollar sellers hit pause for US inflation data
news.summary: The trade and sentiment-sensitive Australian dollar rose by nearly 1% through Monday to sit at $0.6921 early on Tuesday and the New Zealand dollar rose even further to trade at $0.5624, with both steady in morning Asia trade.

news.title: Global Market Today: Asian stocks rally after US tech surge, oil slump
news.summary: South Korea’s Kospi Index jumped more than 5% in early trading while Japan’s Nikkei 225 rose nearly 3%. A broader gauge of Asian shares advanced 1.5% while futures for US benchmarks edged higher.

news.title: When is next stock market holiday? Check date for Nov weekday; NSE-BSE closed for Prakash Gurpurab Sri Guru Nanak Dev Ji
news.summary: Indian stock markets will close on 24 November 2026, for Guru Nanak Jayanti, with regular trading resuming 25 November. The NSE and BSE will suspend trading across equity, derivatives, securities lending and borrowing, and currency segments.

news.title: MRF dividend 2026: India's most expensive ₹1.25 lakh stock but ₹3 in Q2; down 21% in 1 year - Record, payment date
news.summary: MRF declared an interim dividend of ₹3 per share for FY27, with November 17, 2026, set as the record date and payment due on or after December 1. The announcement came as quarterly net profit fell 28% to ₹369 crore, pressured by higher costs despite revenue growth.

news.title: NSE new BKC Mumbai building design: First look! See pics, video of new landmark architecture of National Stock Exchange
news.summary: The bhoomi pujan ceremony was attended by NSE Chairperson Srinivas Injeti, Managing Director and CEO Ashishkumar Chauhan, along with members of the exchange's board and senior leadership team.

news.title: Tata Steel’s domestic business shines in Q2; Netherlands uncertainty poses risk
news.summary: The overseas businesses were subdued as lower sales volumes offset the benefit of 33% and 16% y-o-y growth in realizations in the UK and the Netherlands, respectively.

news.title: Wall Street Boom! US stocks attract massive $2.1 trillion inflows since 2020; Asia, Europe lag behind - Kobeissi Letter
news.summary: US equity funds have attracted $2.1 trillion since 2020, including $1.5 trillion since early 2024. Their inflows were 4.5 times those of emerging market Asia funds, while European funds saw withdrawals.

news.title: FPIs return to India stock markets with ₹53.7k cr inflows in Nov so far - Attraction point for investors? What's next?
news.summary: After selling Indian equities for much of 2026, foreign investors returned as buyers in November, lifting markets and narrowing year-to-date outflows. Market experts point to India’s appeal amid an AI-stock sell-off, along with earnings growth, valuations and possible capital-market tax reforms.
